system.notes:
12-foot-tall, red devil with three sets of wings and three sets of ivory horns. Master of infernal contracts and deals.

AC 15, HP 109, ATK 4 +3 trident +10 (1d6+3), MV far (fly), S +6, D +5, C +6, I +5, W +5, Ch +6, AL C, LV 23

Ashen Essence. 1/round, If struck by an attack, turn into ash and teleport near, then reappear, taking no damage.

Impervious. Fire and cold immune. Only damaged by silver or magical sources.

Profane Gift. As an action, offer a wish to a mortal who can hear archdevil. If accepted, mortal becomes chaotic, devout worshipper.

Visineir, Quill. As an action, scribe a magic circle or write a contract granting mighty boons and patronage in exchange for a sworn soul.

Shadowfinder Complete Bestiary
